subject: Final runbook: MAP milestones, go/no-go signoff, and signature timing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Carter <jenna@olive-sys.com>, Will Barrett <will.barrett@olive-sys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + eval timeline — propose final signoff path and signature windows

Hi Jenna / Will —

Thanks again for the productive eval sessions last week. Per our mutual action plan (attached), we pushed a short checklist that maps approvals to owners and dates. Two asks to lock this down today so we can finalize e-sign routing:

1) Confirm the internal approver list for procurement + security (who signs the SOW vs who authorizes budget).
2) Confirm preferred e-sign provider (DocuSign vs Adobe Sign) and whether legal needs to countersign after procurement.

Quick proposal: we target a go/no-go exec signoff on Friday 8/27 by 3pm PT. That gives us a 48-hour DocuSign window to complete signatures and set an LZ start date of Monday 9/6. If any approver needs an earlier review cycle, flag below and we’ll hold a 30-minute alignment call.

Attached: Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP with checkpoints), SOW-draft-OLV.docx (redline-ready).

Next steps for Olive Systems: reply with the approver names + preferred e-sign tool; we’ll update SignatureMatrix.csv and route the envelope.

Thanks —
Marissa

Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the tidy MAP. Quick responses:

- Approvers: Procurement (ProcureCorp Purchasing inbox - purchasing@procurecorp.com) will sign commercial terms; Legal (I’m copying Will to confirm) will do a final review but Procurement signs SOW. Our CFO (Alyssa Li) will give exec go/no-go.
- E-sign: We prefer DocuSign for enterprise workflows.
- Timing: Friday 8/27 by 3pm PT works for the exec decision, assuming legal’s light redlines are back by Thursday EOD.

I’ll send a short email to procurement to confirm the signing contact; copying Will for legal timing.

Jenna

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + eval timeline — propose final signoff path and signature windows

Jenna / team —

Couple of operational notes from the eval side to avoid surprises during procurement signoff:

- Start date dependencies: if Olive keeps the 9/6 LZ start, we need final model selection (gpt-medium-22q) and agreed throughput target by 8/27 EOD so we can pre-warm dedicated capacity.
- Security evidence: Kimberly, please see the MAP section on SOC2 artifacts. Jenna — procurement will ask for the SOC2 PDF and an IP protection addendum; we can push those into the DocuSign envelope as PDF exhibits.
- Signature order suggestion (SignatureMatrix.csv): 1) Procurement (purchasing@procurecorp.com) sign commercial SOW 2) Legal (Will) counter-sign 3) Olive exec (Alyssa Li) final go/no-go stamp 4) Redwood exec countersign (Marissa) — this sequence reduces hold time for procurement.

If that order works for Olive, I’ll prepare the envelope and share the DocuSign link for a test-sig.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Will Barrett <will.barrett@olive-sys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jenna Carter <jenna@olive-sys.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + eval timeline — propose final signoff path and signature windows

All —

Legal looked at the SOW draft overnight. High level: we only have two small redlines (data processing clause + indemnity cap language). Procurement confirmed they can sign the commercial terms as-is pending the legal clarifications; Alyssa can make the exec call once legal signs off Thursday morning.

We prefer the signature order Karthik suggested. DocuSign is fine. Please:

- Marissa / Redwood: include a SOC2 PDF & network diagram as exhibits in the envelope (makes procurement’s review faster).
- Kimberly: if you can provide the final wording we agree on for the indemnity cap, I’ll route that back to procurement.

I’ll coordinate Alyssa’s availability — tentatively holding 8/27 2:30–3:00pm PT for the exec go/no-go.

—Will

Team — quick status and final runbook:  

- Legal redlines: K. Park provided the indemnity language this morning; Will, I attached the agreed clause into SOW-draft-OLV.docx and added it as an exhibit in DocuSign.
- SOC2 & network diagram: attached to the envelope per Will’s note (Redwood_SOC2_2026.pdf, network-diagram.pdf).
- DocuSign envelope: created and sent this afternoon with the SignatureMatrix.csv order embedded. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=9F4A-OLV-2026 (test link).
- Exec decision: Alyssa confirmed and gave go/no-go call at 2:45pm PT — GO. Procurement completed signature at 3:30pm PT. All parties signed; final countersign from Redwood recorded at 3:58pm PT.

Start date and onboarding: Olive confirmed day-one ops runbook and kickoff is Monday 2026-09-06. Camila — can you lead the onboarding checklist and coordinate a 9/6 10:00am PT kickoff with engineering + CS?

Closing notes: I’ve uploaded the fully executed SOW and the MAP snapshot to the HubSpot deal (link above). Attaching the signed PDF in this thread: SOW-OLV-executed.pdf.

Good work everyone — welcome aboard, Olive Systems.

Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
